summary: CompanyPage is now the company layout: breadcrumb, header, CompanyTabs, the status notice, and an <Outlet> whose context holds { company, reload, onStartDiagnosis, onStatusAction }. CompanyDiagnosesTab is the index route and shows the same v1 content: the CompanyTimeline, the empty state that starts the first diagnosis, the note about prefilled answers, and the archive/restore/delete links. CompanyTabs uses NavLink route tabs (data-aioson-id tab-diagnosticos / tab-relatorios, aria-current=page). They sit right under the header so 'Relatórios' is in the first fold. The bronze line under the active tab draws only under prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference. App.tsx nests the index child under empresa/:companyId.

findings.summary: The nested route 'relatorios' was not added to App.tsx because src/features/reports/ReportCenterPage.tsx does not exist yet (unit phase-1-frontend-report-center, wave 4). Until integration adds the route, the 'Relatórios' tab links to /empresa/:companyId/relatorios, which falls through to the NotFound screen.

AC-ra-61 e2e (the 'Relatórios' button in the first fold at 1280 and 390 px, on the company page and on the result) was not run. tests/e2e/report.spec.ts belongs to another unit, and the result-page button belongs to phase-1-frontend-result.

evidence.command: pnpm exec playwright test tests/e2e/companies.spec.ts tests/e2e/history.spec.ts
evidence.result: 15 passed. The index tab keeps the v1 timeline, empty state, archive/restore/delete and the 390 px + axe checks on the timeline.

messages.text: Wire the report center in src/App.tsx inside the empresa/:companyId route, next to the index child: import { ReportCenterPage } from "@/features/reports/ReportCenterPage" and add <Route path="relatorios" element={<ReportCenterPage />} />. The CompanyTabs 'Relatórios' link (data-aioson-id="tab-relatorios") already points there.

ReportCenterPage renders as a child of the company layout. Read the company with useCompanyOutlet() from "@/features/companies/CompanyPage". It returns CompanyOutletContext { company: Company; reload(): void; onStartDiagnosis?(companyId): Promise<{id}>; onStatusAction(action) }. StartDiagnosisButton is exported from the same module for the empty state (BR-ra-01). The layout already renders the header and the tabs, so the page should render only its own content, with its own h2.

Run the AC-ra-61 check once the report route and the result button exist: pnpm exec playwright test tests/e2e/report.spec.ts at 1280 and 390 px. The company-page selector is [data-aioson-id="tab-relatorios"]. The tab nav has aria-label 'Seções da empresa' and data-aioson-tour 'abas'.
